label: Golden Dawn — Reorganized Table
description: The Golden Dawn reorganized the Great Table's elemental quarters, changing which element corresponds to which quadrant. They introduced the Tablet of Union and added Hebrew letter correspondences. This arrangement, produced by S.L. MacGregor Mathers, became the dominant form in 20th-century Western occultism.

dateRange.notes: Golden Dawn active period; exact date of Mathers' rearrangement unknown

provenance: Mathers accessed Dee's manuscripts and produced the Golden Dawn's rearranged version. He reorganized the elemental quarters, introduced the Tablet of Union as a central coordinating device, and assigned Hebrew letter correspondences not present in Dee's original.

modifications.description: The Golden Dawn reassigned the elemental quarters. Air is assigned to East (NW quadrant on grid), Water to West (NE quadrant), Earth to North (SW quadrant), Fire to South (SE quadrant).

The Golden Dawn extracted the letters of the central cross and constituted them as a separate ritual object, the Tablet of Union (a 5×4 grid: EXARP / HCOMA / NANTA / BITOM). This object does not exist as a separate entity in Dee's manuscripts.
modifications.reason: To provide a unifying Spirit element bridging the four elemental tablets

tabletOfUnion.note: Extracted from the central cross. The Golden Dawn constitutes this as a separate 5×4 grid governing Spirit. Each row corresponds to an element: Spirit of Air (EXARP), Spirit of Water (HCOMA), Spirit of Earth (NANTA), Spirit of Fire (BITOM).

stateData._dataStatus: TRANSCRIBED — Golden Dawn Tabula Recensa. Sourced from two independent digital transcriptions (necronomi.com, aumha.org). All 4 God-name triplets and 22/24 Senior names verified by positional reading. Cross-check against Regardie 1984 ed. recommended.
